casefold_norm.py.src:
import unicodedata

def same_text(a, b):
    a = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", a).casefold()
    b = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", b).casefold()
    return a == b

print("STRASSE".lower() == "straße".lower())
print("STRASSE".casefold() == "straße".casefold())
print("Cafe\u0301".casefold() == "CAFÉ".casefold())
print(same_text("Cafe\u0301", "CAFÉ"))

stencil_walk.py.src:
import re

text = "a1 b22 c333"
stencil = re.compile(r"\d+")
pos = 0
while pos < len(text):
    m = stencil.prefixmatch(text, pos)
    if m:
        print(f"try {pos}: fits {m.group()!r}")
        pos = m.end()
    else:
        print(f"try {pos}: no")
        pos += 1
print(stencil.findall(text))
